The coordinator checks: - % of strings translated - Any fuzzy-flagged entries - Missing critical sections . BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_CheckCompleteness . Check what is served candidate, extracted Ask the root URL and every document address. 2xx or 3xx answers; 404 is not there; 403, 407, 5xx or no answer is about the way here and could not be determined. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_CheckServed . Check what was staged candidate, extracted site.ts --check and readme-book.ts --check: every document at its address, no address taken by another file, every link on the page landing. This is the QA of what would be pushed. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_CheckStaged . Choose a candidate candidate, extracted A one-off choice between surviving candidates. Rejected candidates are kept, with the reason each lost. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/wireframe-design-review.bpmn#Call_Choose . Choose a destination, or none candidate, extracted A PERSON'S STEP, and none is one of the answers rather than a refusal to answer. A requirement whose whole content is carried by the code becomes a commit and nothing else; a graph that acquires a node for it is a graph with a node nobody will ever read. The default creates NOTHING. An agent that decides on its own that a requirement "is really a skill" has manufactured a node nobody asked for, in a graph somebody else maintains — which is what this step exists to prevent. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-signoff.bpmn#BA_ChooseKg . Choose from the offered options candidate, extracted The question is presented as a short list of selectable options, never as free prose, and the list names the top-level content types the agent knows about. The answer becomes the statedIntent fact and the table is evaluated again — the user's answer is read as evidence, like any other fact. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_AskIntent . Choose subgraphs, the asset policy, harnesses candidate, extracted Written to the entry as subgraphs, assets.policy (none, on-demand or all) and harnesses. Choosing is not holding: a chosen subgraph is still referenced until the gates below let it through. Choosing nothing is legitimate — a subscription with no parts chosen is a pinned reference, the case associatedHarnesses covers today. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Task_Choose . CI Gate Verification: Audit Manifest & Schemas candidate, extracted Validate that subgraph-manifest.json conforms to NQuadsDistributionManifestSchema, all referenced partitions exist, and external schema w3c-n-quads is satisfied. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/nquads-distribution.bpmn#A_GateCheck . Circulate the draft [content-review] candidate, extracted The draft publication is circulated to the review team for formal review. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_CirculateDraft . Cite the author of every narrative candidate, extracted A generated description is a claim by someone. Record whether a human or an agent wrote it, and for an agent the model version. An uncited narrative is indistinguishable from a transcription of the source. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-derive-content.bpmn#Task_Provenance . Claim it (status: in-progress) candidate, extracted Idempotent. Claim BEFORE working, and note the branch, so a sibling session can see the item is taken rather than discovering it by collision. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/bean-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Claim . Claim or open the bean [todo-manager] candidate, extracted Every edit is tracked as a bean in beans/. Check for an existing bean by exact title first; claim it (status in-progress) rather than minting a duplicate. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_ClaimBean . Claim the work item candidate, extracted Claim before you work. A claim ANNOUNCES rather than reserves until the PR exists, which is why the branch is announced at the next step and not at the end. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/code-change-review.bpmn#Task_ClaimBean . Classify every conflicted path against the declared patterns candidate, extracted The first matching pattern decides: take-base, generated-regions, qa-sidecar, or refuse. A path no pattern names refuses. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-base.bpmn#Task_Classify . Classify what changed candidate, extracted Prose, code nodes, or both. This is the only decision the generic lane makes on its own: everything after it is made inside a subprocess by the role that lane binds. Binds content-review, the same skill as Task_Consolidate in this lane, since placement PR3 (bean 63wl): it named semantic-review-scoping, a paper skill folio-assistant-sci owns, which this harness diagram cannot reach. A paper process that wants semantic scoping adds it by calling this process. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/review-task.bpmn#Task_ClassifyChange . Clinical / scientific sign-off [content-review] candidate, extracted Domain sign-off: clinical SMEs for a guideline, subject-matter reviewers for a paper. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_SmeSignoff . Close issue ONLY on BA authorisation candidate, extracted Reachable only through BA_Confirm, which is the BA saying every criterion is met. An agent must never close an issue without that explicit authorisation — the gate is the preceding task, and this name says so rather than leaving a reader to trace the flow for it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-close.bpmn#A_Close . Close the bean, merge commit as evidence candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-refusal.bpmn#Task_Close . Close the publication manager's alert, if open candidate, extracted A clean publish resolves whatever the last failure raised: close the open publication-manager tracking issue with a comment naming this run. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/docs-site-publish.bpmn#Task_CloseAlert . Close the release beans [todo-manager] candidate, extracted What shipped is resolved; what slipped stays open and carries into the next cycle. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_CloseReleaseBeans . Close the session candidate, extracted Records that the actor stopped. It does NOT resolve beans or complete instances: those outlive the session by design, and a machine that closed them on the way out would be asserting work finished because somebody went away. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/session-state-machine.bpmn#A_CloseSession . Close the tracking issue candidate, extracted Clean: close the open ci-health issue, if any, saying why (main is clean). Runs only on a clean verdict — on unknown the issue is left untouched and the job fails instead, because could-not-check is never rendered as clean. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/ci-health-watch.bpmn#Task_Close . Close the tracking issue candidate, extracted Clean: close the open pr-no-checks issue, if any, saying why (every open pull request's head now has a CI run). Runs only on a clean verdict — on unknown the issue is left untouched and the job fails instead, because could-not-check is never rendered as clean. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/pr-checks-present.bpmn#Task_Close . Close the tracking issue candidate, extracted Clean: close the open repo-health issue, if any, saying why (every check ran and none had anything to report). Runs only on a clean verdict — on unknown the issue is left untouched and the job fails instead, because could-not-check is never rendered as clean. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/repository-health-watch.bpmn#Task_Close . Close the tracking issue candidate, extracted Closed automatically when every pin is current, so the issue's existence is the state rather than a log of past states. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/upstream-pin-watch.bpmn#Task_CloseIssue . Close the window back to its avatar candidate, extracted [x] closes the window back to its avatar. Only a person's [x] does this; a zoom-out never closes a window, or [x] and zooming become indistinguishable to the reader. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-open-close.bpmn#A_Close . Close-out candidate, extracted The stakeholders sign off, the BA confirms every criterion is met, and only then does the agent close the issue. Never the other way round: an agent must never assume completion. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#Call_Close . Code node review candidate, extracted Descend into Process_CodeReview. The actor takes on the code-reviewer lane for this call path only. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/review-task.bpmn#Call_CodeReview . Collate findings into a report candidate, extracted Mechanical results and review findings are merged into one report against the proposed change. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_CollateFindings . Collect or reconstruct a handover report per agent candidate, extracted Use the agent's own report and check it against live state; if none, ask the agent if it is still reachable, else reconstruct with the handover-report template and mark it reconstructed. Unpushed state is unknown, never empty. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/stalled-agent-triage.bpmn#A_Collect . Comment on the open issue, naming the step candidate, extracted Add this failure to the open issue as a comment (which notifies), and refresh the body to the latest state. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/publish-alert.bpmn#A_Comment . Comment on the PR once, linking the bean candidate, extracted One comment per refused PR, edited in place on every later event. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-refusal.bpmn#Task_Comment . Comment ONCE per (PR, head sha) candidate, extracted Comment on each affected open PR once per (PR, head sha): a hidden marker carrying the sha is checked first, so a re-run on the same head stays silent and a new push can be reported again. A PR that is no longer open is skipped. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/pr-checks-present.bpmn#Task_Comment . Comment staging URL on PR candidate, extracted Bot comments or updates the staging URL on the PR. Includes commit SHA, branch name, and build log link, and the review list of rendered files the change alters (skill rendered-impact), each linked on the preview and on main, with any input the renderer could not place named as not known. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_CommentPR . Comment the preview URL on the PR candidate, extracted Post, or update in place, one comment on the PR giving the preview URL (STAGING/<slug>/) and the commit it was built from. Pull-request events only. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Comment . Commit a tip without the pruned entries candidate, extracted One new commit whose tree lacks the pruned entries, parented on the current tip, through the same fetch → rebuild → push loop as a publish: no -f, three attempts. History is not rewritten — truncating it is a deletion of a different order and the owner's call (deletion-requires-confirmation), not a scheduled job's. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/qa-publish.bpmn#Task_ApplyPrune . Commit into the corpus candidate, extracted Only now does the change become corpus content, together with its QA sidecars. Subject to the commit-hygiene requirement. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_Commit . Commit the merge candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-base.bpmn#Task_Commit . Commit, push, open the PR candidate, extracted The PR opens at the FIRST commit, even on a stub, and permission is never asked for it. Holding a green PR back for someone to look at is not caution — it is a blocked reviewer. A change to a rendered surface carries a before/after preview in the PR body (skill before-after-preview). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/code-change-review.bpmn#Task_CommitAndOpenPR . Commit, push, update PR candidate, extracted Agent commits all changes to the feature branch and pushes. The feature-staging.yml workflow automatically deploys to STAGING/<branch-slug>/ and comments the URL on the PR. For a rendered change the agent also produces the before/after preview (skill before-after-preview) and links it in the PR body. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_CommitPush . Compare main vs staging candidate, extracted The review starts from the Change Set's RENDERED list (skill rendered-impact): every rendered file the change alters, predicted from each renderer's dependency cone and checked against the build. The reviewer opens every content page on it, not only the pages the author mentions; index files are listed but not reviewed. An input the renderer could not place is shown as not known, never as no change. Review committee opens both URLs side by side: - Main site: <pages-url>/ (current published state) - Staging: <pages-url>/STAGING/<branch-slug>/ The staging banner shows the commit SHA so they can verify what they are reviewing matches the PR. A changed figure, diagram or table is also pictured before and after on the review page, with the share of changed pixels in words (skill visual-diff, Tool folio-block-screenshots). Anything the staging job cannot picture (page chrome, scroll behaviour, a PDF page, an IG page) is in the agent's before/after preview (skill before-after-preview). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_CompareBeforeAfter . Compare what the processes need with what is granted candidate, extracted The needed set is the agent-permissions skill's list (write generated projections: CI only, never the agent; edit hooks or settings; run the gates; push a feature branch; open a PR), scoped to what this instance's processes actually call. The granted set is the recorded grants plus the Tool's current config, read through its adapter. A config rule with no recorded grant is reported as unrecorded, not treated as granted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/secure-agent-permissions.bpmn#Task_ReadGrants . Complete (no unchecked todos left) candidate, extracted Only once nothing is unchecked, and with a summary of what changed. The engine's resolve completes a bean only after the instance itself has completed — whether work is done is a judgement, and a bean is not closed on someone else's say-so. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/bean-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Complete . Compose the message candidate, extracted Five required strings — timestamp, actor, process, task, message — and one optional markdown body. The five are required because each answers a question a reader of the log will otherwise have to guess, and a guessed answer in a log is worse than a missing one. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/log-message.bpmn#A_Compose . Confirm all criteria met candidate, extracted The business analyst confirms every acceptance criterion from the requirements is met. The issue closes only on their authorisation — an agent never closes an issue on its own say-so. Since issue #2405 (FR-013) it IS an adjudication with the requirement-set answers: an approval here moves the set to accepted, which check:requirements refuses unless it is a human's and every approved member is in-force. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-close.bpmn#BA_Confirm . Confirm main's CI on the merge commit candidate, extracted Read the runs on the merge commit. Red is fixed forward (continual-progress). With no CI the report reads "not verified: no CI", never green. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-to-main.bpmn#Task_ConfirmBase . Confirm needs statement candidate, extracted Stakeholders confirm, on the issue, that the needs statement says what they need — or say what to change. A stakeholder's judgement; an agent does not record it for them. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-needs.bpmn#S_ConfirmNeeds . Confirm the cardinalities candidate, extracted An operational question, asked of the people who run the process because they know where the exceptions are. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#S_ConfirmCardinality . Confirm the entities are the ones meant candidate, extracted A naming question. The BA owns the domain vocabulary; the agent does not guess, which is CRDM's own rule for phase 1 and applies here with more force. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#BA_ConfirmEntities . Consolidate findings candidate, extracted One report from however many subprocesses ran. Findings are advice: a reviewer cannot accept the change. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/review-task.bpmn#Task_Consolidate . Consolidate into 2-4 themes, with a recommendation each candidate, extracted Group by what the work delivers, not by agent. Each theme gets its epic, members, dependencies, risk, and one of: continue, fold in, new epic, park, scrap (owner only). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/stalled-agent-triage.bpmn#A_Consolidate . Coordinate? How? candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/related-work.bpmn#U_Coordinate . COPYRIGHT per bitstream, and for the derived work candidate, extracted What the licence permits for THIS bitstream, and separately whether it permits the derivation. LICENSE-CONTENT.md exists in this repository and the ingestion pipeline does not read it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Copyright . Create feature branch candidate, extracted Agent creates a feature branch from main. Branch naming: feature/<short-description> Opens a PR immediately (AGENTS.md: "open the PR at the first commit"). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_CreateBranch . Create the bean (agent CLI, not an engine op) candidate, extracted beans create "<title>". This is the AGENT's call. The workflow engine has no create op — its vocabulary is claim, note and resolve, all of which act on an instance's existing bean. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/bean-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Create . Create the repositories candidate, extracted The owner creates the content and tools repositories and their Pages. Nothing is committed to them before this. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_Create . Create the repository candidate, extracted Only on the new-repo branch, and only after the user has named it. An empty working directory is scaffolded in place instead. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_CreateRepo . Cross the axes into SO, WO, ST, WT candidate, extracted The TOWS matching step, and the only step that produces anything actionable. Strengths and weaknesses across, opportunities and threats down, and each cell names the strategy the pairing implies: SO — achieve opportunities that greatly match the strengths; WO — overcome weaknesses to attain opportunities; ST — use strengths to reduce vulnerability to threats; WT — prevent weaknesses, to avoid becoming more susceptible to threats. A SWOT that stops at four lists is the failure the source names as its central one. This step is what the process exists to reach. It produces CANDIDATE strategies, not a chosen one, and they are not ranked — see the process documentation on why no scoring activity exists. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/swot-analysis.bpmn#A_Cross . Cut the subgraph that leaves candidate, extracted Apply the editorial scope mechanically and report what it removed. A selection that reports nothing cannot be told from one that ran over an empty rule. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-to-portal.bpmn#A_Select .

623.title: D
623.content: Data model Entities + cardinalities candidate, extracted Between requirements and sign-off, and the order is the argument: requirements are statements about things, and the model says what the things ARE. Drafted earlier it is invented from nothing, since the entities come from the phase-2 BPA; drafted later, sign-off approves requirements whose nouns were never pinned — which is how two stakeholders approve one sentence meaning different things. Owner, 2026-09-20. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#Call_DataModel . Decide each theme candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/stalled-agent-triage.bpmn#U_Decide . Decide what may leave the repository candidate, extracted EDITORIAL, and it is stage 1 rather than a filter bolted to the exporter. kg-export produces the WHOLE graph because inspection wants the whole graph; a portal wants what its readers may see. Running the second as the first is how a QA verdict, a bean's blocking note or an unpublished draft reaches a public cache. Decided once, here, rather than at each consumer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-to-portal.bpmn#E_Scope . Decide, weighing the recommendations candidate, extracted public-comment decide, or decide: code on GitHub from a login in config.json editors. accepted, accepted-modified, not-accepted, noted, deferred; a reason for all but accepted. Also reopens a decided comment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment.bpmn#Task_EditorDecides . Declare Distribution Manifest & Named Queries candidate, extracted Write subgraph-manifest.json conforming to folio-nquads-distribution/v1. Declare datasetIri, servedRoute, spine, subgraphs, and audited named SPARQL queries with explicit requiredSubgraphs and typed parameter definitions. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/nquads-distribution.bpmn#A_DeclareManifest . Declare the model where a tool can read it candidate, extracted A model in prose is a proposal; a model in the declaration is a model. Ship a reader in the same change — everything here that was only documentation went inert within weeks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#A_Declare . Declare the mount: harness, repository, pin candidate, extracted An instance { name, source: { remote: { repository, ref } } } in the downstream's root index.config.json, written through writeDeclaredMounts. A folio with no index still reads remoteMounts on its declaration; both at once is refused. ref is a full 40-character commit. Overrides, if any, are keyed by instance name and then by directory id — never by path. The index itself is the index-config skill's. Decide first whether you want a remote mount at all: reading another graph without holding its code is a SUBSCRIPTION, not a mount. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-dependency.bpmn#Task_DeclareMount . Declare the node materialized candidate, extracted The node's state moves from referenced to materialized, carrying purpose, localPath, gates and (archival) fixity. There is NO default state: a node that has not said is invalid, because 'the author did not say' and 'the author said they could not tell' are different facts. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Declare . Declare the purpose: working or archival candidate, extracted working or archival, and it is asked FIRST because three of the five gates mean different things under each. An archival copy keeps the original bytes, never expires, requires fixity, and is the only thing that discharges sourceLoss; a working copy keeps derived content and discharges none of that. A process that gated first and asked afterwards would be judging a copy whose obligations it did not yet know. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Purpose . Deduplicate, and keep what is actually relevant candidate, extracted The paper's Refiner. Accumulates into the evidence set the report is built from — so what is dropped here is invisible downstream, which is why it is a step somebody performs rather than a filter buried in retrieval. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/deep-document-research.bpmn#A_Refine . Deploy the MVP to staging candidate, extracted An MVP is shared AS A STAGING DEPLOY, not as a description of one. feature-staging.yml publishes the branch under STAGING/<branch-slug>/ on gh-pages and comments the URL on the PR, so the stakeholder who tests it is looking at the built artefact rather than at a screenshot — the same argument the merge discipline makes about rendered work. Measured in this repo on 2026-09-16: holding a rendered change back for assessment made assessment harder, not safer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-deliver.bpmn#A_DeployStaging . Deploy the rendering candidate, extracted Commit the staged tree onto gh-pages as a full replace (the instance's Pages workflow on a push to main, or by hand); GitHub Pages then builds it from the branch. Rebuild and retry on a rejected push; never rebase the branch. The gh-pages commit SHA is the message the report names. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_Deploy . Deploy to STAGING/<slug>/ candidate, extracted peaceiris/actions-gh-pages deploys to gh-pages branch under STAGING/<branch-slug>/ with keep_files: true so other staging deployments and the main site are preserved. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_DeployStaging . Derive content from the assets [document-intake] candidate, extracted See ingest-derive-content.bpmn. Most of this subprocess is not implemented yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_Derive . Derive the key [main/<sha> or pr/<n>/<sha>] candidate, extracted qa:publish --github reads the event: a push to main publishes under main/<sha>/, a pull request under pr/<n>/<head-sha>/ — the head that was tested, not the merge ref. It also reads whether the token can write, which the gateway after it routes on. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/qa-publish.bpmn#Task_DeriveKey . Derive the slug from the head ref candidate, extracted Derive the slug from the PR's head ref: every character outside [a-zA-Z0-9._-] becomes '-', runs of '-' collapse, and leading or trailing '-' is trimmed. It must be one safe path segment, checked by value. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Slug . Describe the desired change candidate, extracted Author describes the content change in natural language. Example: "Update the immunization schedule to add a booster at 18 months." . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the intended change candidate, extracted The editor states the change in natural language; no content has moved yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the need (chat, issue, discussion) candidate, extracted The BA describes the capability gap in their own words. They do not need to know it is called CRDM. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#BA_Submit . Detect change scope & impact candidate, extracted Agent analyses the requested change: - Which content blocks are affected? - Are there downstream implications (indicators, referral logic, visit schedules)? - Will deterministic logic (CQL/DMN) need updating? skill: content-graph, integration-watcher . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_DetectScope . Detect feature request (crdm-detect skill) candidate, extracted Recognise the request as a platform capability change rather than content work, from crdm-detect's signals. Never call it "CRDM" to the person. Mid-content-work, ask whether to pause for requirements now or record a bean for later — do not switch on your own. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#A_Detect . Detect media type and mint a doc id [document-intake] candidate, extracted Sniff the media type rather than trusting the extension, and mint the doc id from the page-1 arXiv stamp where there is one, else from the filename. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Detect . Detect the interaction modality candidate, extracted Before the first question is asked, establish HOW to ask it: audio, ordinary chat, selectable options for a user with limited hand function, large-type for low vision. A user who finds the questions unusable never reaches the rest of this diagram. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_DetectModality . Determine the context: what is known, and already decided candidate, extracted Before composing anything: what is already known, each fact with where it came from; which declaration governs the matter (the instance's <name>.json, the diagram the caller is in, the Skill its task names); what state is recorded; and whether the question has ALREADY been decided — by the person earlier in the conversation, or in a declaration that quotes their ruling. A settled question is not asked again: asking it reopens a decision and spends the person's attention twice. Read it, do not remember it: cite what you read. What the caller handed in is checked here, not re-derived. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineContext . Determine the process and task, or that you are idle candidate, extracted Name the Process, the lane and the task the question belongs to, and say so in the message: "Process: Initialize a harness, at Determine the harness and repositories, as the Bootstrapping Agent". A reader who does not know which process you are in will assume the last one's rules still hold. If you are in no Process, that is an answer too: you are IDLE, and what you are doing is classifying a request to find the Process it belongs to — say that, rather than presenting a question as though a step had asked for it. You are OUT of process, and it is undetermined, when you cannot name the instance, when two candidates fit, when the step you believed was next is not the one the diagram enables, or when the work in hand was not what you said you would do. Do not infer your way back in. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineProcess . Determine the roles: which you act as, and the person's candidate, extracted An Actor performs a task in a Process AS a Role. Nothing is a Role by nature: the same agent is the Bootstrapping Agent in one diagram and another Role in the next, and which one it is depends on the lane of the task it is performing now. So say which Role you are acting as — the lane of the CALLING task, since this lane is variable — and which Role the person you ask holds (the Requestor, or whoever the calling lane names). It decides what you may ask them for: only the Requestor chooses a harness, and a question put to somebody who does not hold the decision gets an answer that settles nothing. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineRoles . Determine where you are: process, roles, context candidate, extracted Before narrowing, say where this is happening, in the words you will use in the question. PROCESS: Initialize a harness, at its first step, inside Determine the harness and repositories — the only place a Bootstrapping Agent can be (FR-2). If you cannot say that (you were started some other way, or a step you believed done is not), you are out of process: do not infer your way back in. ROLES: you act as the Bootstrapping Agent because you were told so; the person you will ask is the Requestor — the one who asked for the harness, and the only one who may choose it. A request relayed by somebody else leaves the Requestor undetermined. CONTEXT: what the request said, and what the checkout holds — a declaration at its root, a harness named in the request. Whatever cannot be determined is handed to the called discussion as undetermined, and asked about first; it is never filled with a default. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineWhere . Determine which harness, and where candidate, extracted The candidates are listed and the Requestor is asked, in discussion, which asks through human-agent-discussion. IN: nothing but the context this agent was handed. OUT: zero or ONE harness, and the locations — a document conforming to discussion.output.schema.json. One at most: a list of two is not an answer, and the Bootstrapping Agent may not break the tie itself. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_DetermineHarness . Discard all entries, or a whole session candidate, extracted Remove every entry, one session's, or those before a date — emptyLog with { all }, { session } or { before }; there is no default selector. A file that will not parse is kept, and the result must say what was refused and why, not only what was removed. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/activity-log.bpmn#A_EmptyAll . Discard one entry by id candidate, extracted Remove one entry by its stable id, with emptyLog({ id }). Logs are the one exception to the never-delete rule because an entry records no decision; the exception covers files that declare folio-log/v1, not the directory. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/activity-log.bpmn#A_EmptyOne . Dispatch one agent, recorded on the bean candidate, extracted Before the agent starts: the date, why the fail condition fired, the agent's id, its budget. Never while the first writer may still be live. Two failed attempts with the same cause go to the owner instead. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-refusal.bpmn#Task_Dispatch . BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/adjudication.bpmn#A_Dispatch . Do it, then check again candidate, extracted Only what the agent, or a tool it has, can do without replacing anything somebody wrote: regenerate a README section, add a missing Pages workflow, switch Pages on with an authenticated gh. Performing is not the same as done: the flow goes back to the check, and only the check says done. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_PerformStep . Do the work candidate, extracted The task itself. This diagram says nothing about how it is done; it only brackets it, so that a reader of the log can tell where one run of work began and ended. For a rendered change it also produces the before/after preview (skill before-after-preview) here, before Gateway_ValidationFork, so the preview exists when the parallel review starts. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DraftEdit . Draft, review and publish [content-publish] candidate, extracted See draft-to-publication.bpmn. Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the pull requests seed:ready named until the source settles, then ask again. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/sub-kg-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Drain . Sweeping first would make the board authoritative over the folio for one step. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-relocate.bpmn#A_UpdateLayer . The agent watches rather than chases: an arrival may be minutes or days away. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/content-acquisition.bpmn#P_Upload .

624.content: Edit deterministic logic (if needed) candidate, extracted If the content change affects decision logic, indicators, or workflows: - Update CQL expressions - Update DMN decision tables - Adjust indicator definitions skill: dak-authoring, fhir-pipeline . Content in a writable directory is authored content and is edited where it lives; the copy-out is for somebody else's bytes, not for yours. Validates each edit against the schema (content_validate). skill: content editing, block builders . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_EditContent . Its PR says Closes #N for the change-set issue, and opening it moves that issue's accepted comments to editing. Flows to Task_PoInject, so the round-trip QA runs again over the corrected text — "edit the translation and re-run QA", which is what the adjudication step has always offered and what this process could not do. A userTask, not a service task: this is the one step here where a person edits content, and the lane's actor is the reviewer who just adjudicated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_EditTranslation . Editing and HCI validation [content-author] candidate, extracted See editing-hci-validation.bpmn. Runs once per proposed change, not once per cycle. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Editing and HCI validation [content-author] candidate, extracted The editing sub-process. Every change to the corpus goes through its HCI validation gate — a red draft is fixed there, never by patching the built artifact. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Eject the culprit, record why candidate, extracted T1 (R3; SQ19 §2.2 p. 3): the culprit leaves, the rest re-run. Writes ejection on its queue entry (train id, reason, evidence URL, when) and a dated evidence snapshot on this instance. The train is never rejected whole for one member. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-train.bpmn#Task_Eject . End-to-end + accessibility (HARD) candidate, extracted Install Chromium, check the rendered BPMN SVGs are current, then run the Playwright suite, which includes the accessibility checks. Hard: a failure blocks the PR. SHARDED since bean dlqu (drawn as one task, deliberately: a multi-instance marker would add a BPMN term to every instance's UML overview, about 75 generated files, for a picture this sentence already gives): the suite runs as three e2e-shard jobs (E2E_SHARD=i/3, one Playwright worker per core in each), and each shard is its own required check, so a shard that failed, was cancelled or never ran is a red check of its own. Until bean 5p4m (issue #2456) an e2e job carried one check name for the three and completed the task only when every instance succeeded; it was ~1 s of work behind a runner request that waited minutes, and was removed. Measured before the split: playwright test alone was 4m33s of a 5m16s job, the workflow's slowest once bun test ran in parallel. The BPMN-render and .bat-wrapper checks run in shard 1 only, so they are asked once. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/code-quality-gates.bpmn#Task_E2E . Ensure the publication-manager label candidate, extracted The alert is a tracking issue labelled publication-manager — the role, not a person, because no actor declares a GitHub account for it. Whoever watches that label is alerted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/publish-alert.bpmn#A_Label . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted Create the ci-health label with --force so it exists before either issue path runs — the close path filters on it too, and on a repository that has never had a finding it would not exist yet. Skipped on an unknown verdict. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/ci-health-watch.bpmn#Task_Label . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted Create the pr-no-checks label with --force so it exists before either issue path runs — the close path filters on it too, and on a repository that has never had a finding it would not exist yet. Skipped on an unknown verdict. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/pr-checks-present.bpmn#Task_Label . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted Create the repo-health label with --force so it exists before either issue path runs — the close path filters on it too, and on a repository that has never had a finding it would not exist yet. Skipped on an unknown verdict. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/repository-health-watch.bpmn#Task_Label . ENUMERATE + SUBSET against the source descriptor candidate, extracted Resolve the request against the source's descriptor (one per corpus, in the declared sources/ of the instance that owns it, e.g. who-iris/sources/), read against cat-harness/schemas/source-descriptor.ts BEFORE any gate. Three things come from it and none may be guessed. (1) Which subset strategies the source supports — supportsSubset(). (2) Whether a subset stands on its own: when subsetIsSelfContained is false (mathlib), the request is closed over its dependencies here, and every gate after this one is asked about the CLOSURE, because a subset that omits what its members depend on is not a smaller corpus, it is one that does not build. (3) What enumerating the whole costs — enumerationCost(), which is undefined when the descriptor has no measured denominator; SIZE then refuses rather than estimates. A source with no descriptor is not an error here: it is an unknown, and SIZE refuses on it. Bean w5bn: the descriptor is CALLED here rather than restated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Enumerate . Establish origin and licence candidate, extracted Authors, publication, identifier, and the licence the source itself states. No stated licence means reference only: headings, page ranges and a summary in our own words; the file stays in uploads/ (git-ignored) pinned by checksum. A method with no origin is a house process; write a skill instead. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Origin . Establish the licence from the upload alone [document-intake] candidate, extracted EARLY, by the owner's ruling on bean 7bg9 (2026-09-20): before any derivation, because library/ is holds: content and anything derived first is committed, so refusing it later is a deletion nobody may take unasked. This step sees only the upload itself — the licence recorded in its intake.json (the same stated / unknown record a library manifest carries) and whether a LICENSE file sits beside it. It never infers a licence from extracted text. The verdict is stated, unknown, or UNDETERMINED, and undetermined is never reported as cleared: the pipeline proceeds and says so, because a licence that only extraction can reveal is a later check's to find. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Licence . Every other field is recoverable by reading the repository; who is acting is not. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/session-state-machine.bpmn#A_IdentifyActor . Every identifier dereferences candidate, extracted After the release is live, every published identifier resolves to the file it names. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Tools . Execute every case, or skip it with a reason candidate, extracted Every case in dependency order. A case is executed or explicitly skipped with its reason; a case that simply has no verdict is a finding, because it cannot be told from a case nobody ran. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/test-plan-execution.bpmn#A_Execute . Explain each missing permission, with the exact config diff candidate, extracted Per permission: what it allows the agent to do without asking, why a process here needs it, the narrowest form that would do, and the exact change to the Tool's config. Context, options, recommendation, question (interaction-modality §4.1). Least privilege is the recommendation unless there is a measured reason for more. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/secure-agent-permissions.bpmn#Task_Explain . The unpublished graph typologies are stripped on export. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/docs-site-publish.bpmn#Task_Export . Extract & Skolemize RDF Dataset candidate, extracted Extract the target RDF triples and ensure strict upstream skolemization: transform every blank node into a deterministic IRI under the dataset namespace. Zero blank nodes allowed in serialized N-Quads. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/nquads-distribution.bpmn#A_ExtractSkolemize . Extract claim candidates candidate, extracted candidates.json holds extracted theorems and definitions. Proposals only -- never adjudicated verdicts. Extract its metadata into the KG [asset-extraction] candidate, extracted THE METADATA STEP. What enters the knowledge graph is the asset's INDEX — what it is, how big, what type, when it says it was written — and, for a container, what is in it; its contents do not go in unless somebody asks, with a reason. Owner, 2026-09-20: "make sure you have zip ingestion skills to extract metadata of assets into KG. don't extract contents unless explict ask by user." The tool is cat-harness-tools/scripts/extract-assets.ts, writing a folio-extraction/v1 record (schemas/extraction.ts, moved down to this layer in placement PR5). The media type is sniffed from the leading bytes, never taken from the extension. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_ExtractMetadata . Normalizes whitespace 4. Extracts metadata (titles, alt text, captions) Produces .pot file(s) at the configured granularity. Tool: translation_extract MCP tool .
